Skypass Travel Inc (Group) is a premier travel and tourism service provider dedicated to delivering seamless and memorable travel experiences. Established with a commitment to excellence, we specialize in corporate travel management, leisure tours, and customized travel solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. Our services include flight bookings, hotel reservations, holiday packages, visa assistance, and travel insurance.
At Skypass Travel, we combine technology-driven solutions with personalized customer service to ensure efficiency, reliability, and convenience. With a team of highly trained travel professionals, we strive to provide every client with a smooth and hassle-free travel experience, reflecting our brand promise: “Your Passage, Our Priority.”
Vision: To be the most trusted and innovative travel partner, delivering extraordinary travel experiences globally while setting the standard for professionalism, integrity, and customer satisfaction in the travel industry.
Mission:
- To provide seamless and end-to-end travel solutions with a focus on efficiency, reliability, and personalization.
- To leverage technology to simplify travel planning, ensuring timely and accurate services.
- To foster long-term relationships with clients, partners, and employees through trust, transparency, and exceptional service.
- To continuously innovate and adapt to evolving travel trends while upholding the highest ethical and professional standards.

chapters.title: h. Commitment to Continuous Learning and Development
chapters.text:
- Participate actively in training, workshops, and development programs provided by the company.
- Stay updated with industry trends, travel sector knowledge, and new tools to enhance performance.
- Seek feedback, learn from experiences, and continuously improve professional skills.
## Ethical Client and Vendor Interactions
- Maintain professional and respectful communication with clients, suppliers, and partners.
- Avoid giving or receiving improper benefits, gifts, or incentives that may compromise ethical standards.
- Ensure transparency, accuracy, and fairness in all client transactions and reporting.
## Reporting Violations and Workplace Concerns
- Employees are encouraged to report any breaches of workplace standards, ethical concerns, or unsafe practices to their manager, HR, or through the confidential reporting channel.
- All reports will be treated seriously, investigated promptly, and handled with discretion.
- Retaliation against employees who report concerns in good faith is strictly prohibited.
By adhering to these workplace standards, Skypass Travel ensures a safe, respectful, and professional environment that enables employees to thrive, maintain client trust, and contribute positively to the organization’s mission.
## Recruitment, Selection & Joining Procedures
At Skypass Travel Inc (Group), we are committed to attracting, selecting, and onboarding the most talented and qualified individuals while ensuring transparency, fairness, and compliance with all applicable employment laws. Our recruitment processes are designed to reflect our organizational values, promote diversity, and provide a positive candidate experience.
Skypass Travel strongly believes that continuous learning and skill development are essential to organizational success and individual employee growth. We are committed to creating a high-performance culture by providing structured training, development opportunities, and career advancement support to all employees. Through well-planned learning initiatives, we ensure that our workforce remains competent, confident, motivated, and future-ready. This policy outlines our approach to employee training, development programs, learning support processes, and expectations from stakeholders.
- Purpose of the Training & Development Program
The Training & Development framework has been established to:
- Enhance employee capabilities, knowledge, and professional skills
- Support career advancement and performance improvement
- Equip employees with technical, functional, and behavioral competencies required for their roles
- Strengthen organizational efficiency and service quality
- Promote a learning culture that encourages growth and innovation
- Align employee skills with evolving business needs and industry standards
- Types of Training Programs Provided
Skypass Travel conducts a wide range of learning and development initiatives, including but not limited to:
New Employee Onboarding & Induction Training
- Orientation to company culture, policies, and ethics
- Introduction to products, services, technology platforms, and organizational structure
- Department-level technical and process training
- Workplace safety, compliance, data privacy, and behavioural training
Role-Specific Technical & Functional Training
- Travel reservation and ticketing systems (e.g., GDS platforms)
- Visa processing, travel documentation, and customer support operations
- Client management, routing, pricing systems, and industry knowledge
- Aviation and tourism regulatory compliance requirements
Leadership & Managerial Development Programs
- Supervisory skills, team management, delegation, and conflict resolution
- Coaching, mentoring, and performance evaluation skills
- Decision-making, innovation, strategy planning, and resource management
Soft Skills & Behavioral Competency Training
- Communication and interpersonal skills
- Customer service excellence and relationship handling
- Stress management and emotional intelligence
- Time management, presentation skills, and professional etiquette
Digital Capability & Technology Enhancement
- Training on new software systems and internal digital platforms
- Cybersecurity and responsible data handling
- Productivity tools and digital transformation systems
Compliance, Safety & Mandatory Certifications
- Workplace health and safety standards
- Anti-harassment and Code of Conduct training
- Anti-bribery, anti-corruption & ethical trade practices
- Travel industry regulatory compliance
- Prevention of Child and Forced labor
- Performance-Based Learning & Career Development
Employee training and development are connected to:
- Performance evaluation outcomes
- Skill gaps identified during assessment cycles
- Individual Development Plans (IDPs)
- Succession planning and future leadership potential
Outstanding training completion can be considered for:
- Promotions
- Salary revisions
- Special assignments
- Internal job transfers

chapters.title: Equal Opportunity
chapters.text:
Skypass Travel provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without any form of discrimination, exclusion, or bias at every stage of the employment lifecycle, including recruitment, selection, onboarding, training, performance evaluation, promotion, career progression, compensation, transfers, work assignments, rewards, and disciplinary actions, regardless of:
- Gender, gender identity, or sexual orientation
- Age or life stage
- Race, color, caste, nationality, or ethnic origin
- Religion, beliefs, or cultural background
- Marital, pregnancy, or parental status
- Physical or mental disability or medical condition
- Language or socio-economic background
Veteran status or any other protected characteristic under applicable laws
## Workforce Planning & Job Requirement Identification
- Workforce Planning:
- The HR department, in consultation with department heads, conducts workforce planning to identify current and future staffing needs.
- Recruitment decisions are based on organizational growth, operational requirements, employee turnover, and strategic business goals.
- Job Analysis & Role Definition:
- Each open position undergoes a thorough job analysis to define roles, responsibilities, qualifications, skills, experience, and reporting structure.
- Job descriptions and person specifications are documented and approved before initiating recruitment.
## Recruitment Process
- Internal Recruitment:
- Skypass Travel encourages internal mobility by providing opportunities for employees to apply for new positions or promotions within the organization.
- Internal candidates are evaluated based on performance, experience, skills, and potential for growth.
- External Recruitment:
- Open positions are advertised through multiple channels including the company website, job portals, professional networks, and recruitment agencies.
- Efforts are made to attract a diverse pool of candidates and ensure equal opportunity.
- Screening and Shortlisting:
- Resumes and applications are reviewed by HR and the relevant department head.
- Candidates are shortlisted based on qualifications, relevant experience, skills, and alignment with organizational values.
- Age Verification:
- To prevent child labour and young workers job advertisements will specify that candidates must be at least 18 years old.
- Age verification will be conducted through government-issued identification, such as an Aadhaar card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driver's License, before the interview.
## Selection Process
- Interviews:
- Shortlisted candidates undergo structured interviews, which may include multiple rounds: HR interview, technical interview, and managerial interview.
- Interview panels assess candidates against role-specific competencies, communication skills, problem-solving abilities, and cultural fit.
- Assessments (if applicable):
- Depending on the role, candidates may be required to undergo written tests, practical exercises, case studies, or psychometric assessments to evaluate technical proficiency, aptitude, and personality traits.
- Reference Checks:
- References from previous employers or professional contacts may be obtained to verify employment history, performance, and conduct.
- Background verification, including educational and identity verification, is conducted as per company policy and legal requirements.
- Equal Opportunity Commitment
- Skypass Travel ensures that all recruitment and selection practices are merit-based.
- Hiring decisions are based on qualifications, skills, experience, and alignment with company values.
- The Company prohibits discrimination based on gender, age, religion, caste, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic.
- Equal opportunities are provided for all candidates, including internal and external applicants.
## Prevention of Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Trafficking
At Skypass Travel, we are firmly committed to ethical labor practices and ensuring that every individual associated with the Company is treated with dignity, fairness, and respect. The Company strictly prohibits any form of child labor, forced labor, or human trafficking in all aspects of its operations, including direct employment and through contractors, vendors, or partners.
## Child Labor Prevention
- Skypass Travel strictly adheres to national labor laws and international conventions regarding the minimum age for employment.
- No individual under the legal working age is employed in any capacity.
- Age proof documents (birth certificate, passport, or government-issued ID) are verified for all candidates during recruitment.
- Any discrepancies or doubts regarding a candidate’s age result in immediate disqualification from employment.
- Recruitment teams and managers receive regular training on the identification and prevention of child labor.
- Awareness campaigns ensure that all employees understand the importance of ethical labor practices.

chapters.title: Employee Performance evaluation
chapters.text:
- Purpose
The purpose of this policy is to establish a standardized, transparent, and fair process for evaluating employee performance at Skypass Travel Inc (Group). The performance evaluation system enables the organization to assess individual contributions, work efficiency, professional behavior, and skill development against defined expectations.
This structured evaluation approach supports informed decision-making related to:
- Annual increments and salary adjustments
- Promotions and role enhancements
- Confirmation of employment after probation
- Training, skill development, and career advancement plans
- Performance improvement measures where needed
Through this system, Skypass reinforces accountability, encourages professional growth, and maintains a performance-driven culture aligned with the company’s service excellence standards and organizational values.
- Scope
This policy applies to all employees of Skypass Travel, including office staff, field employees, team leaders, executives, supervisors, and managers across all business locations.
The performance evaluation process is applicable to:
- Probationary employees
- Confirmed full-time employees
Participation in performance evaluation is mandatory and forms a key component of our employee development and retention framework.
- Responsibilities
The effective implementation of this policy is a shared responsibility between HR, Department Heads, and Employees.
[table]
| Role | Responsibility |
| Human Resources Department | Initiates the evaluation cycle, circulates evaluation forms, consolidates result |
| HOD / Reporting Manager | Reviews performance objectively, assigns ratings, provides feedback, conducts re |
| Employee | Completes self-evaluation honestly, participates actively in review discussions, |
| Management | Approves final rating outcomes, increments, promotions, and corrective actions. |
- Evaluation Frequency
Performance evaluations at Skypass Travel Pvt. Ltd. are conducted according to the following schedule:
[table]
| Type of Evaluation | Frequency | Purpose |
| Quarterly Review | 4 times a year | Track ongoing performance and feedback |
| Annual Appraisal | Once a year | Determine annual salary increments and career progression |
| Probation Review | After 6 months of joining | Confirm continuation of employment |
- Evaluation Criteria
Employees are evaluated using a structured 5-point Performance Rating Scale (1 = Poor, 5 = Outstanding) across core performance categories such as:
- Job Performance & Work Quality
- Communication Skills
- Individual Work Characteristics (initiative, responsibility, discipline, time management)
- Team Collaboration & Behavioral Conduct
- Job Knowledge, Technical Skills & Learning Attitude
- Customer Service Orientation
- Other performance-based parameters as required
Both Self-Evaluation and Manager/HOD Evaluation are included to ensure transparency and equal participation.
- Performance Evaluation Procedure
- HR initiates the evaluation cycle and shares the Performance Evaluation Form along with schedule & deadlines.
- Employees complete the Self-Evaluation section and submit it to their HOD.
- The HOD assesses performance objectively using defined criteria and assigns scores with written remarks describing:
- Key strengths and accomplishments
- Areas of improvement and gaps
- Future goals and growth recommendations
- A Performance Review Meeting is conducted between the employee and the HOD to discuss results, expectations, and development needs.
- HR and HOD jointly prepare an Individual Career Development Plan (ICDP) outlining training needs, skill development goals, and career growth initiatives.
- HR consolidates all scores and supporting documents and shares them with Management for review and final approval.
- Final outcomes are communicated to employees formally, along with acknowledgment signatures.
- Employees needing improvement receive a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) with defined timelines and progress reviews.
- Performance Score Outcome
[table]
| Score Range | Evaluation Result | Action |
| 4.5 – 5.0 | Outstanding | Fast-track growth, special recognition, bonus eligibility |
| 4.0 – 4.4 | Excellent | Higher-than-standard increment consideration |
| 3.5 – 3.9 | Good | Standard increment |
| 3.0 – 3.4 | Needs Improvement | Assigned to PIP |
| Below 3.0 | Unsatisfactory | PIP / disciplinary action based on review |
- Individual Career Development Plan (ICDP)
Prepared after each quarterly and annual evaluation, ICDP includes:
- Setting short-term and long-term career goals
- Identifying skill gaps and training requirements
- Assigning mentors and learning opportunities
- Defining measurable milestones & timelines
- Periodic follow-up by HOD & HR to track progress
The ICDP ensures structured growth aligned with employee potential and business needs.
- Documentation & Record Control
- HR maintains all evaluation forms, score sheets, review notes, and signed acknowledgments.

chapters.title: Remediation Procedure
chapters.text:
The remediation procedure at Skypass Travel is designed to provide comprehensive, timely, and employee-centered support for individuals who raise workplace grievances. The process prioritizes the physical safety, emotional well-being, and dignity of affected employees, while ensuring fairness, accountability, and compliance with company policies. Remediation efforts not only aim to resolve the immediate concern but also prevent recurrence through systemic improvements and proactive measures.
- Scope of Grievances
Grievances may arise from a variety of workplace situations. Each category requires a tailored and proportionate remediation response. Examples of issues include, but are not limited to:
- Workplace environment and working conditions
- Health, safety, and travel-related concerns
- Terms and conditions of employment
- Human rights concerns, including child labor, forced labor, or trafficking
- Interpersonal conflicts or team relationship issues
- Discrimination, harassment, or bullying
- Job role clarity, workload, and career growth concerns
- Application or interpretation of company policies
- Performance-related disputes
- Compensation, benefits, or recognition concerns
- Root Cause Analysis
After resolving a grievance, Skypass Travel conducts a thorough root cause analysis to identify underlying systemic gaps. This ensures that similar issues are prevented in the future. The analysis is conducted collaboratively by HR, relevant Department Heads, and involved employees. The process includes:
- Reviewing all facts, timelines, and decisions related to the grievance
- Evaluating relevant policies, SOPs, and operational workflows
- Identifying recurring patterns, procedural gaps, or internal control weaknesses
Insights from this analysis guide targeted corrective and preventive measures across the organization.
- Proportionality: Identifying Appropriate Responses
Skypass Travel ensures that all remedial actions are proportionate to the grievance's nature and severity, while prioritizing the needs of the affected employee. This includes:
- Consultation with the Employee: HR engages directly with the employee to fully understand the impact and collaboratively identify the most appropriate remediation measures.
- Restorative Actions: Depending on the grievance category and impact, remediation may include:
- Psychological Support: Access to counselling, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), or mental health support.
- Professional Support: Coaching, mentoring, or skill development to restore confidence and career growth.
- Workplace Adjustments: Changes in reporting structure, work assignments, shift schedules, or office arrangements to ensure comfort and safety.
- Financial Remedies: Reimbursement or compensation for financial loss directly resulting from the grievance.
- Sanctions for Perpetrators: Where misconduct or policy violation is confirmed, Skypass Travel applies appropriate disciplinary actions ranging from warnings, mandatory training, suspension, to termination based on severity and evidence.
- Transparency: Communication with Stakeholders
Maintaining clear and transparent communication during grievance handling is critical for fairness and trust:
- Right to Information: Complainants receive timely updates on key actions, decisions, and outcomes, while ensuring confidentiality.
- Documentation: HR maintains structured records of all proceedings, decisions, and actions. Employees may request access to their case-related records.
- Open Dialogue: Regular conversations ensure employees feel supported, heard, and safe throughout the process.
- Monitoring: Ensuring Effectiveness
Post-remediation, Skypass Travel conducts systematic monitoring to confirm that corrective actions are effective and that no retaliation occurs:
- Regular Follow-ups: Scheduled check-ins at defined intervals (e.g., 7, 30, 60 days) to assess employee well-being and satisfaction.
- Workplace Monitoring: Observation of team dynamics and office environment to prevent recurrence of issues.
- Feedback Channels: Anonymous reporting channels for employees to share concerns about the grievance or remediation process.
- Long-Term Support and Prevention
Beyond individual grievance resolution, Skypass Travel commits to long-term measures to strengthen workplace culture:
- Preventive Training: Regular sessions on anti-harassment, discrimination prevention, conflict management, and respectful workplace practices.
- Policy Review: Periodic evaluation and updates of grievance-related policies and SOPs to ensure clarity, compliance, and relevance.
- Conclusion
The remediation procedure at Skypass Travel reinforces the company’s commitment to a fair, respectful, and safe workplace. Through employee-centered support, proportional corrective actions, transparent communication, continuous monitoring, and preventive measures, all grievances are addressed thoroughly, responsibly, and with utmost sensitivity.

chapters.title: T Security Policy – Information Security Management System (ISMS)
chapters.text:
- Purpose
The IT Security Policy establishes a comprehensive Information Security Management System (ISMS) designed to safeguard all-digital, physical, and operational information assets belonging to Skypass Travel Pvt. Ltd. The policy ensures that information systems remain protected against unauthorized access, misuse, data breaches, loss, damage, and cybersecurity threats. It supports business continuity, protects customer trust, and ensures compliance with applicable legal, contractual, and regulatory frameworks.
- Scope
This policy applies to:
- All full-time, part-time, contract, temporary employees, consultants, vendors, and partners
- All offices, workstations, remote or hybrid workplaces, and digital platforms
- All information assets including emails, documents, databases, cloud systems, booking systems, financial and HR systems
- All IT infrastructure: servers, networks, communication tools, software, personal and company devices
- Information Security Objectives
- Ensure confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA Triad) of all information assets
- Protect sensitive and personal data from theft, loss, alteration, damage, or unauthorized disclosure
- Implement preventive, detective, and corrective controls to minimize security risks
- Reduce operational disruptions through proactive threat monitoring and IT controls
- Foster a culture of cybersecurity responsibility and awareness for all employees
- Ensure compliance with applicable data protection laws such as IT Act 2000, GDPR (if handling EU data), and contractual service obligations
- Roles & Responsibilities
Executive Management
- Provide leadership and allocate resources for ISMS implementation
- Approve security strategies, policies, and risk treatment plans
- Review periodic security performance and incidents
IT & Security Officer
- Implement security controls, backups, antivirus systems, network monitoring, and cybersecurity tools
- Conduct regular internal audits, threat assessments, and vulnerability tests
- Manage access control and system configuration
Department Heads
- Ensure employee compliance with ISMS within the business unit
- Report incidents and risks promptly to IT security
Employees
- Maintain password confidentiality and follow security guidelines
- Report suspicious emails, breaches, or unusual system behavior
- Use company data and systems only for authorized business purposes
- Access Control
- Access to systems is granted strictly on the principle of Least Privilege and Need-to-Know.
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) must be used where applicable.
- Passwords must meet minimum complexity standards:
- Minimum 8–12 characters
- Must include uppercase, lowercase, number & special character
- Password sharing is strictly prohibited.
- Accounts will be locked after repeated failed attempts.
- Access rights are reviewed at least bi-annually and revoked immediately on exit.
- Data Protection & Confidentiality
- All confidential, sensitive, customer travel data, booking information, and financial records must be encrypted during storage and transmission
- Employees must use only approved company software, systems, and email platforms for work
- Usage of personal email, USB drives, or cloud storage for company files is strictly prohibited unless approved
- Documents must be labelled according to data classification categories (Public / Internal / Confidential / Highly Confidential)
- Network & Infrastructure Security
- Firewalls, intrusion detection systems (IDS), antivirus, antimalware, and endpoint security controls must be installed and actively monitored
- Wi-Fi networks must be password protected, and guest networks must be isolated from internal systems
- Remote access must occur only through secure VPN
- Unauthorized installation of software or hardware is prohibited
- Email & Internet Usage
- Company email is the official communication channel; personal accounts must not be used for business
- Employees must avoid opening unknown attachments, phishing emails, or accessing unsafe websites
- Downloading pirated software or engaging in illegal digital activity is strictly prohibited
- Cloud & Data Backup Management
- Automated scheduled backups must be carried out daily/weekly depending on data category
- Backup copies must be stored securely and tested periodically for restoration capability
- Cloud services must be approved by IT and comply with security standards
- Incident Response & Reporting
- All security incidents such as malware, phishing attempts, data exposure, unauthorized access, or system failure must be reported immediately to the IT Security Officer
- IT team will initiate containment, investigation, evidence collection, recovery, and post-incident review
- Incident records must be documented, analyzed, and reviewed for improvement
- Bring Your Own Device (BYOD)
- Personal devices may be used for business purposes only with written IT approval
